class_label: toilet tissue, toilet paper, bathroom tissue
focus_areas: Geometric verification of flat vs. cylindrical structure via depth mapping
Spatial coherence and boundary integrity between paper and box
Legibility and artifact analysis of printed graphics/text
Physical plausibility of paper drape and rigidity
custom_prompts_for_reflector: The image depicts an object labeled 'toilet tissue' but visually presents as a flat, printed sheet hanging from a box, lacking the defining cylindrical roll structure, cardboard core, and perforations. The Judge rejected the previous plan for missing geometric and text verification. Use the geometric_depth_auditor to definitively prove the object is flat (lacking roll volume) and check for spatial bleeding. Use the image_text_auditor to analyze the printed figures for gibberish/artifacts. Use open_vocabulary_detector to ground the topology audit. Evaluate whether this significant structural deviation constitutes a failure to meet the class definition, prioritizing the objective geometric evidence over semantic assumptions.
image_description: A white sheet of paper, resembling toilet tissue or a paper towel, hangs vertically from an open cardboard box mounted on a wall. The paper features a vertical column of printed graphics: three gold/yellow abstract figures at the top and one black figure at the bottom. The paper appears flat and lacks the cylindrical volume of a standard roll. The background includes a beige wall and carpeted floor.
